messages:
alex: quick ping — PR 4821 ready for sec eyes. touches: KMS key policy tweak, audit-log enrichment for key use, and a tiny secrets-service client change. want to ship today if all good. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4821

maria-security: on it. brief summary of change? did you add any new IAM roles or cross-account grants?

alex: no cross-account grants. main change is allowing the secrets-service to call kms:GenerateDataKey for the new key alias. also added a structured audit field `kms_operation_context` to our log lines.

kevin-platform: can you paste the new key policy here? quick skim.

alex: sure — snippet below:
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "Service": "secrets.redwood.internal" }, "Action": "kms:GenerateDataKey", "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```

maria-security: a couple things: 1) Principal should be an explicit IAM role ARN not a service string. 2) Resource = "*" is risky if this key lives in multi-tenant env; scope to the key ARN. 3) add kms:Decrypt on the usage path if you expect decrypt later.

alex: good catches. i can change principal to `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/secrets-service-prod` and scope resource to `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef01`. also i'll add kms:Decrypt.

jordan: CI flagged one failing test in secrets-client (timeout flake). ci-bot: build 4821 — failed — unit/secrets-client/test_timeout.rs (flaky).

alex: doh — i'll re-run and push fix. committing quick retry + tighten timeout.

kevin-platform: also add an audit log regression test. we didn't have structured kms_operation_context before; want a small unit test asserting field present on successful GenerateDataKey path.

alex: added test, pushed 1778002a. CI now: ci-bot: build 4821 — passing — all checks green.

maria-security: thanks. two nit asks: include a comment in policy why role ARN is chosen (for future reviewers) and add an entry in security/changes.md summarizing the audit enrichment. after that I'm +1.

alex: done both. linked changes.md in PR description.

kevin-platform: tagging for merge window — we can merge after maria signs off. opsly will handle rollout.

maria-security: LGTM. approved. :white_check_mark:

alex: awesome — merging now. will monitor logs for any unexpected KMS errors. cc @sarah for oncall handoff.

sarah: got it, will watch for alerts and look for the new kms_operation_context field in traces. :mag:

ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for infra/pr/4821 — canary in us-west-2 scheduled.
